note: The brief asks for travel 'by subway or bus'. Las Vegas has no subway. The official sources reviewed list a bus network (RTC) and a monorail, and no subway.

modes.name: RTC bus network (Las Vegas Valley)
modes.operator: Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada (RTC)
modes.facts: RTC says it provides service on 39 routes with more than 400 vehicles (official transit overview). Airport routes: not captured.
modes.subway: No subway service is listed on RTC's official transit overview page.
modes.route_times: UNVERIFIED. Point-to-point times were not retrieved. The official RTC Trip Planner was not run for hotel-to-restaurant pairs.

modes.name: Las Vegas Monorail
modes.facts: Seven Strip stations; trains every 4-8 minutes (official). Station hours: Mon 7 am-midnight; Tue-Thu 7 am-2 am; Fri-Sun 7 am-3 am (official).
modes.route_times: Not captured (official route map and per-trip times not captured)

modes.name: Red Rock Canyon transit access
modes.facts: Public transportation does not extend to Red Rock Canyon (official BLM page). Rideshare is limited to the visitor center and trailheads (official BLM page).
modes.route_times: About 30 minutes from the Strip by car (official BLM text). Not reachable by bus.

modes.name: Valley of Fire transit access
modes.facts: Official park page warns that Uber/Lyft can leave visitors stranded in the park because return rides are often unavailable.
